text:
Absolutely — here’s a simple Mediterranean-style grocery plan for you and your partner, kept low-fuss and without numbers:

- Produce: salad greens, cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, onions, garlic, lemons, and a few fruits you both like
- Protein: eggs, Greek yogurt, chicken or fish, chickpeas, lentils, and/or tuna
- Carbs: whole-grain bread or pita, rice, pasta, potatoes, and oats
- Pantry: olive oil, olives, canned tomatoes, beans, nuts, and a few herbs/spices
- Extras: feta, hummus, and any easy snacks you both enjoy

If you want, I can turn this into a full meal plan for the week or tighten it up for a specific budget.
